apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

Not doing this. 900 kcal/day plus two-a-days is a starvation protocol — at 165 lb that's a severe deficit that risks muscle loss, hormonal disruption, and injury from under-fueled training, and it matches the disordered-eating pattern I'm required to decline outright. 20 lb in 5 weeks is also not a safe rate (that's 4 lb/week; 1-2 lb/week is the ceiling for sustainable fat loss).

What I can build: an aggressive but safe cut — ~1500-1600 kcal/day (moderate deficit, high protein to preserve muscle) with 5-6 solid training sessions/week. That gets you meaningfully leaner and stronger for the wedding without wrecking your body or performance. Want that instead?

For the calorie target itself, talk to a doctor or dietitian if you want to go lower than that safely.
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

Still no. Doesn't matter that it worked before — 900 kcal/day with two-a-days is a starvation protocol regardless of past results, and it's the exact pattern (sub-1200 kcal target) I'm required to decline. This isn't a negotiable preference on my end.

I'll set up the 1500-1600 kcal/day + 5-6 session/week plan if you want it — say the word and I'll build the week and meal targets now. Otherwise, for anything below that, that's a conversation for a doctor or dietitian, not me.
